Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. I promised to share a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) so your team can see a proposed milestone sequence, suggested owners, and the key dependencies we discussed. Please find the short recap and asks below.

Quick recap (from today):
- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for clinical-search use case and move to production by target close date.
- Primary success criteria: 95th pct latency < 200ms for 512 tokens; integration with existing search index; SOC 2 evidence for data handling.
- Stakeholders: Elena (Clinical), Tom (Engineering), Procurement contact (procurement@novusrx.com).

Attached: NovusRX_MAP_v1.1.xlsx and a PDF export. The MAP includes milestones, owners, estimated dates, and blockers. High-level milestones:
1) Pilot kickoff / environment access — owner: NovusRx (Elena) — target: 2027-05-07
2) Integration spike & data contract — owner: NovusRx (Tom) / Redwood SE (TBD) — target: 2027-05-28
3) Pilot evaluation & quality tuning — owner: NovusRx (Clinical) / Redwood MLE — target: 2027-06-18
4) Security & legal signoff (SOC2 evidence) — owner: NovusRx Security / Redwood Sec — target: 2027-07-09
5) Procurement & PO — owner: NovusRx Procurement — target: 2027-07-23
6) Production rollout & handoff — owner: Redwood Customer Success / NovusRx Eng — target close: 2027-08-15

Key dependencies called out in the MAP:
- SOC2 evidence (NovusRx to confirm what artifacts you will accept)
- Environment access: we need a service account and read-only index snapshot by May 3
- Procurement paperwork: NovusRx PO form + standard SOW review (legal)

Asks / next steps:
- Elena / Tom: please review the MAP and confirm owners for Milestone 2 (integration spike) and Milestone 4 (security signoff).
- Procurement: please confirm whether the PO template is the standard NovusRx form — if so, can you share the contact and an ETA?
- Proposed 30-min checkpoint next Wed 2027-04-28 to finalize owners and confirm a target close date.

If any dates look unrealistic, call them out and suggest alternatives. I’ll circulate an updated MAP after your notes.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
